items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Terminology 15:1
items.html: (To the question) What is BAN of BAN? The left side of the Mochin of Ima is called BAN of BAN. For Ima in its entirety is discerned as the aspect of BAN, and the Hochma and Hesed within it are discerned as MAH of BAN, and the Bina and Gevura within it are discerned as BAN of BAN. (Item 152 and 153).
